overviewParagraphs: Nestled in the pristine Binh Tien coastline, Nara Binh Tien Golf Club is a true hidden gem. The Golfplan design team has brilliantly crafted a course that transitions from rugged natural dunes to lush parkland bordered by water, and finally up into the foothills of the Nui Chua mountains. Every hole offers a distinct character and challenge, heavily influenced by the ever-present coastal winds. The pristine Platinum Paspalum grass ensures perfect lies and fast, true-rolling greens. Beyond the course, the expansive clubhouse offers five-star amenities, making it a perfect retreat after a challenging round. Its remote beauty and top-tier design make it an essential stop on any Vietnam golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Nara Binh Tien Golf Club (opened 2022 in Ninh Thuan Province) is one of Vietnam’s hidden architectural gems — crafted by Golfplan’s Kevin Ramsey and David Dale in a secluded amphitheater where Nui Chua National Park’s forested peaks meet a pristine white-sand crescent beach. Playing 6,718 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the Platinum Paspalum layout balances tranquil inland water holes on the front nine with dramatic dune-lined coastal holes opening straight onto the sea.

Because Binh Tien sits roughly 45 minutes south of Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) along one of Vietnam’s most scenic coastal drives, the course remains wonderfully uncrowded — offering relaxed pace of play, crisp conditioning, and zero high-rise backdrops. It shares Ninh Thuan’s famously dry micro-climate, staying sunny more than 300 days a year.
AGS pairs Nara Binh Tien with Greg Norman’s KN Golf Links Cam Ranh (45 minutes north) for a sun-drenched South-Central Coast twin-course escape anchored at Cam Ranh or Amanoi / Ninh Van Bay.

criteria.label: Nui Chua National Park & Ocean Backdrop

scorecard.verdict: Flanked by the rugged peaks of Nui Chua National Park and the turquoise waters of Binh Tien Beach. One of Vietnam's most visually arresting hidden-gem championship layouts.

faqs.q: How far is Nara Binh Tien Golf Club from Cam Ranh Airport (CXR)?
faqs.a: Nara Binh Tien is approximately 45 minutes south of Cam Ranh International Airport (CXR) along the scenic coastal highway — making it an easy twin-course pairing with KN Golf Links Cam Ranh.

faqs.q: What style of golf course is Nara Binh Tien?
faqs.a: Designed by Golfplan (Par 72, 6,718 yards Blue Tees), Nara Binh Tien blends lush lake-laced mountain foothills with sandy coastal dunes and direct beachfront vistas in an uncrowded national-park setting.

faqs.q: Why is Ninh Thuan / Binh Tien great for weather reliability?
faqs.a: Ninh Thuan is the driest province in Vietnam, enjoying over 300 days of sunshine per year. Even when Central Vietnam sees autumn showers, Nara Binh Tien stays remarkably playable from January through October.

faqs.q: What nearby resorts pair well with Nara Binh Tien?
faqs.a: Ultra-luxury travelers pair Nara Binh Tien with Amanoi (25 minutes south) or beachfront 5-star resorts along Cam Ranh’s Long Beach (35–40 minutes north).
